tldr: WorkArena++ is a benchmark of 682 compositional tasks built on the ServiceNow platform that evaluates web agents' planning, reasoning, retrieval, and contextual understanding abilities on realistic enterprise workflows, revealing that even state-of-the-art LLMs and VLMs largely fail while humans solve tasks with ease.
contributions: Introduction of WorkArena++ benchmark expanding from 33 to 682 tasks with composite, realistic office worker trajectories requiring problem-solving, data-driven decision-making, and memorization

Technical improvements including visual diversity via 10 fictitious companies with customized UIs, improved database isolation through sandboxing, an extendable composition framework, and Oracle-based observation-action trace extraction for fine-tuning
Empirical evaluation showing state-of-the-art agents achieve near-zero success on WorkArena++ while humans achieve 87.5-100% success
methods: The authors built WorkArena++ on the ServiceNow platform using BrowserGym as the interaction environment. They expanded the original 33 WorkArena tasks into 682 tasks organized into two difficulty levels (L2 with explicit step-by-step instructions, L3 with implicit goals delivered via tickets requiring KB retrieval) across five skill categories: planning/problem solving, information retrieval, data-driven decision making, sophisticated memorization, and contextual understanding through infeasible tasks. They evaluated closed-source models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-vision) and open-source models (Llama3-70b, Mixtral-8x22b) with a maximum of 50 time-steps per task, alongside human baseline evaluations.
results: All evaluated agents generally failed on WorkArena++: GPT-4o achieved only 3.0±1.1% on L2 and 0% on L3; GPT-4o-v achieved 3.8±1.3% on L2 and 0% on L3. GPT-3.5, Llama3-70b, and Mixtral-8x22b scored 0% across both levels. GPT-4o-v showed some success on retrieval tasks involving reading charts. In contrast, humans achieved 87.5-100% success across task categories. For reference, agents scored 42.7% on WorkArena L1.
limitations: Current web agents achieve near-zero success rates, indicating significant gaps before useful workplace deployment
The 50-step limit per task may constrain longer workflows
Context truncation was used for some models to fit within token limits
Visual diversity could be further expanded beyond the 10 fictitious brands
